text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... That's interval training done!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what's next on the list? C'mon,
hurry up and tell me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Working with Vodka has been more
straightforward than I expected.
We're
making good progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her long strides and flexible body,
her future looks promising.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Bring it on! I gotta show off how
cool I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap.
I forgot to turn in my application
for the Tracen Meet.
Better get that thing
in quick...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ya don't know? Oh right, there hasn't
been one yet since you
joined the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's basically this big event that happens
twice a year. Everyone signs
up and gets to
pick the type of race they wanna run.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We get people from all over the place
comin' to watch!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Plus,
it's a chance for us pre-debut runners
to test ourselves against
those who've
already debuted.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The best part of this event is that if you
get assigned to the same
group, it doesn't
matter who's debuted or not—all you
gotta do is run!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't wait! I need to make sure
everyone sees my cool side!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And y'know what, Trainer? I think today's
an awesome day to get
some grub outside!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we're on the same page! Wait
right here, Imma go get
changed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Vodka and I head out for a meal.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Daaang, I ate so much! I know I gotta
watch my weight, but it's nice
having a
cheat meal like that once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
D-do you see that super cool poster over
there?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, I see a flashy poster
depicting an Umamusume riding a
big
motorcycle.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A movie, huh... Oh man, it'd be so cool to
see that huge bike on the
screen...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you for real?! Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That... was... the coolest thing I've ever
seen!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Didja see how close they were to the
ground while roundin' those
curves? That
was such a cool chase scene!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How could anyone not be?! I just can't get 'nough of the engine's roar or the sleek body!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, my pops owns one of those bad
boys. When I was little, he'd
always give
me rides around town.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, now those were good times! I'm
telling you, big bikes are where
it's at!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me, the first time I went to
the Japanese Derby, I was on
the back of
my pops' ride.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yep, he loves it! He'd always tell me,
"Vodka, those racers are the
coolest of the
cool."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get it at all the first time he
told
me. But once I saw a race for
real...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: When the gates opened, I instantly got shivers down my spine. You could just feel the tension in the air.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I blinked once from the
beginning till the end. It was the
craziest
thing I'd ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Every racer had these insane auras that
were saying stuff like, "I won't
back down!"
"Get outta the way!" "Victory is mine!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I remember screamin' my head off about
how cool it was during the ride home. I
couldn't really see his face from the
back, but I bet my
pops was grinnin' ear to ear.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I wanted to be just as cool as those
racers!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I had a blast today. Thanks for
lettin' me tag along with you to
the
movies, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but y'know that scene before the
climax... um, the romantic one...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That, well, y'know... kinda caught me by
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely more into action.
I'd prefer
folks comin' in guns blazing
rather than
that uh... k-ki...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
D-don't just say it! Ughhh, now I'm
rememberin' everything!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Agh?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: G-got a nosebleed...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day after our eventful outing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're working our way through one of our
usual training sessions
when another
student appears.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Vodka! You're in Group 10 for
the 2000-meter turf race
at the Tracen
Meet, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh, me? Yeah, what about it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to check if you were
planning
on changing your group...
You still have
enough time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What? Change? Why would I need ta do
that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "why"? Didn't you see
who's in it?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is in your group!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna race against Brian?!
